pretreatments.description: Thermal pre-treatment: Substrates were placed in an oven for temperatures varying from 60 °C to 140 °C with treatment durations of 1 hour (60-80 °C) and 30 minutes (100-140 °C). This method involves physical heating to promote hydrolysis by disintegration and liquefaction of the cytomembrane of the substrate.

Biological pre-hydrolysis treatment: Substrates were incubated in glass vessels flushed with nitrogen at 37 °C and 55 °C for 40 hours (20 hours at different temperatures). The mixture of food waste and inoculum ratio was 10:1 (w/w), which facilitates extracellular depolymerization by acidogenic bacteria into oligomers and monomers.
